2. Event date and venue.
3. Required equipment and quantities.
4. Rental duration.

The refundable security deposit is Rs 5,000 per booking and is payable before equipment handover.

Demo cancellation policy:

• If EventKit cancels before handover: all amounts paid are refunded.

Any balance or security deposit paid for a booking cancelled before handover is refunded in full. Approved refunds are processed within five working days.
